lighthouse.label: Category minimums for the first-visit page, median run.

metrics.label: Maximums for every mobile Lighthouse page, median run. Times are milliseconds; CLS has no unit.

flow.label: Worst INP of any user-flow timespan, per form factor, in milliseconds.

bundle.label: First-load JavaScript of the route in kB, counted as next build prints it. Read from the production build next to audits/, so it is checked only when that build exists and the target is served from this machine; skipped for --target live.

floors.label: Not goals: the live site's scores on 2026-11-15, before the audit fixes. Dropping below one is a regression and fails the run. Raise a floor when its score improves. securityLive applies to the live deployment only, since plain-HTTP local runs cannot measure TLS or headers. readableFirstMs works the other way round: it is the readable step's median first-visit readable time in milliseconds, and going over it fails the run. It sits above the 2.89 s measured live, where a script fade held the page at opacity 0, because throttled loads on a shared machine are noisy.

targets.label: Where these should get to: the scores at or above, readableFirstMs at or below. Reported in SUMMARY.md, never fail the run.
